data.title: 冬马和纱 · 节拍器停下时
data.description: 节拍器终于停下。和纱靠在琴边，低头查看刚写在便笺上的速度标记。
data.action: 和纱靠在琴边，低头查看刚写在便笺上的速度标记
data.promptProse: Resting her hands above the ivory keys of an upright piano, Kazusa focuses intently on the swinging wooden pendulum of an antique metronome. Afternoon window light glints off the polished piano fallboard and metronome brass weights.
data.animaCaption: Paused beside the piano with her fingers poised near the brass metronome and tempo note, she watches the weighted pendulum intently. Diagonal afternoon sunbeams cut through dust motes across the polished wood and open scores.
